# COCCIDIOIDOMYCES

Pulmonary and Infectious Diseases consultations are essential for diagnosis and treatment.

## Duration of antimicrobial therapy

Duration of therapy is dependent upon location and severity of infection, and response to therapy. Consult Infectious Diseases for more information.

## Mild to moderate disease

Observation alone is indicated for some cases. Consult Infectious Diseases for more information. If antifungal treatment is indicated:

References:

- Galgiani et al. Clinical Infectious Diseases. 2016, 63(6) e112-46
- Mandell Chapter: Coccidioidomycosis
- Sanford guide keyword: Coccidioidomycosis
Therapy:
## Inpatient

Preferred:
Itraconazole 200 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]

Alternative:
Fluconazole 400 mg PO q24h ($) [R,DI]

### Severe disease (diffuse pneumonia, rapid progression or central nervous system infection)

Preferred:

Alternative:
Fluconazole 400-800 mg IV q24h ($) [R,DI]

*Local guidance (Des Moines CDSS, Inpatient):*
Amphotericin B 0.5-1 mg/kg IV q24h ($$) [R,O]

## Outpatient

Preferred:
Itraconazole 200 mg PO BID ($) [DI]

Alternative:
Fluconazole 400 mg PO QDay ($) [R,DI]
